summary: A full Nvidia (BUY) earnings preview covering everything investors need to know ahead of Wednesday's report. Couch Investor dismisses Michael Burry's 'lights out' warning given Burry's crash-call track record, then details sky-high expectations: ~100% YoY revenue growth this quarter and ~89% the next, plus ~107% EPS growth and ~93% free-cash-flow growth. His central concern is not the quarter itself — Nvidia 'will crush it' — but whether the market is convinced by guidance and Jensen Huang's messaging on 2027. He lays out the bear case around circular financing: Nvidia's $42.3B in non-marketable private equity, $27B in future investment commitments, deals like OpenAI's $105B energy buildout, and the $500B third-party AI compute financing platform with Apollo/BlackRock/KKR, arguing Nvidia must keep the ecosystem healthy since it would suffer most from failed partners. Other key topics: concentration risk (three customers ~54% of revenue), the $6B Poolside open-weight AI deal aimed at countering Chinese open models, falling token prices actually benefiting neo-clouds via higher GPU utilization, and his conservative DCF implying ~17% upside. Verdict: bullish, but a small sign of uncertainty could crash everything on Thursday.
